method: New symmetric frontal master; elbow rotation only with neutral wrists.

beats.name: Set
beats.state: Bar at thighs; nearly straight elbows; overhand grip.

beats.name: Curl
beats.state: Curl upward with wrists straight; bar raised in front of the abdomen.

beats.name: Squeeze
beats.state: Bar near shoulders; elbows remain by ribs; overhand grip.

beats.name: Brief hold
beats.state: Same high position as frame 3; intentional hold.

beats.name: Lower
beats.state: Return through the same intermediate position as frame 2.

beats.name: Reset
beats.state: Bar at thighs as frame 1; ready for next rep.
